Maya S.: Quick follow-up from the 03/09 postmortem — listing action items and proposed owners/dates. Please confirm or reassign by EOD Tue.

1) Autoscaling fallback for model-variant overflow — Derek H. — due 2026-04-01
2) Runbook: failover steps + rollback playbook — Raj P. — due 2026-03-26
3) KV-cache recovery tests (staging) — Lisa T. — due 2026-03-24
4) Customer comms + support playbook — Jin K. (CS) — due 2026-03-23
5) Audit log gap for Private deploys — Anya V. (Security) — due 2026-04-05

Maya S.: If you don't confirm, I'll auto-assign to the listed owners. Tag me with any scope changes.

Raj P.: I can take the runbook. Couple clarifications — do we include the DB failover steps or link to infra runbook? Also need write access to /docs/runbooks/incident.

Maya S.: Raj — link to infra runbook is fine, but include step to toggle model routing. I'll grant write access now.

Derek H.: I can own the fallback. Need a 2-hour maintenance window to validate on staging. Proposed test window: 2026-03-29 02:00-04:00 UTC. If that works I'll open PR for the routing policy change.

Lisa T.: KV-cache test flaky on nightly. I'll add a deterministic replay test and target 03/24 for validation. Will need a small perf budget bumped on staging for that run.

Jin K.: I'll prepare the tenant notification template and support runbook. Tentative send: 2026-03-23 10:00 PT, pending Derek's staging validation.

Anya V.: Security will triage the audit log gap. Assigning to sec-eng @tom and @sasha, due 04/05. If anyone needs more context, DM me.

Maya S.: Thanks — please confirm final dates by EOD tomorrow. I'll update the postmortem tracker and tag assignees.

-- 1 day later --

deploy-bot: Derek H.'s PR merged: <https://git.internal/repo/PR/2345> :shipit:

Derek H.: PR merged and staged fallback policy applied to staging. Test window scheduled and noted in the runbook PR.

Raj P.: Runbook draft up: <https://confluence/repo/runbooks/incident-2026-03-09> — needs a quick review from eng-sre and product.

Lisa T.: KV-cache deterministic test added to CI, pass on 03/24. Raising follow-up for perf budget with eng-infra.

Jin K.: Customer email queued for 2026-03-23 10:00 PT. Support playbook linked in the ticket.

Anya V.: Sec-eng confirmed remediation plan posted in the security ticket. Target remains 04/05.

Maya S.: All right — manual verification check on 03/25. If all items in tracker show 'done' I'll close the postmortem. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
